english.title: Speeding - cause low platform trailer to exceed 40 miles per hour

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[displaying]_
(B)_[displaying a thing resembling]_

the rectangular plate described in the definition of 'low platform trailer' in the Table in regulation 3(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 at a speed exceeding 40 miles per hour
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 100A(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause use on a road of a vehicle speed exceeding 40 mph
when displaying a low platform trailer plate or similar

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See offence wordings H3283 and H3216 for related offences.
(iii) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence
